CITY OF LA VERNE
  SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  AGENDA

Terry Kistler, Chair  La Verne Community Center
Bette Donovan, Member  Classroom 1
Edward Padgett, Member  3680 D Street
Scott Snider, Member  La Verne, CA 91750
Jenny Jolly, Member  (909) 596-8776
George Borst, Member
Yvonne Duran, Staff Liaison
Armando Cisneros, Staff Liaison
Robyn Olsen, Staff Liaison

  Wednesday, August 20, 2025 – 10:00 a.m.
  La Verne Community Center Classroom 1

Attendance and participation at the City of La Verne Senior Advisory Committee meetings are
welcomed and appreciated. Community engagement provides the Committee with valuable
information. In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the
La Verne Community Center at (909) 596-8776 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Public comments will be allowed near the conclusion of the meeting.

  1. ROLL CALL – Terry Kistler, Bette Donovan, Edward Padgett, Scott Snider, Jenny Jolly,
  George Borst

  2. PRESENTATIONS – Jen Sancen, Senior Companion Director, AgingNext

  3. APPROVAL OF MINUTES – June 18, 2025

  4. DISCUSSION & ACTION ITEMS
  a. Senior Nutrition Program – Armando Cisneros
  b. Meals on Wheels Program – Armando Cisneros
  c. Bingo Report – George Borst
  d. Account Balance Update – Armando Cisneros
  e. Monthly Senior Program Fees – Armando Cisneros
  f. Mt. SAC Classes Update – Armando Cisneros
  g. Aging Next – Armando Cisneros
  h. Facilities Report – Yvonne Duran
  i. Upcoming Events – Robyn Olsen
   5. PUBLIC COMMENT
  Public comments will be allowed on items not on the Agenda but within the subject
  matter jurisdiction of the Committee; however, no action may be taken on off-agenda
  items except as provided by law.

  6. STAFF/COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION/INFORMATION

  7. ADJOURNMENT

  The next regularly scheduled meeting of the Senior Advisory Committee will be held at
  10:00 a.m. on September 17 at the La Verne Community Center, 3680 D Street, La Verne
  CA 91750.

Posting Statement: On August 14, 2025 a true and correct copy of this Notice was posted on
the bulletin board at La Verne City Hall, 3660 D Street, La Verne, and on the City’s website at
www.laverneca.gov
minutes_text:
MINUTES OF THE SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  REGULAR MEETING
  Wednesday, August 20, 2025

  ACTION MINUTES
  “See items in italics”
  _________________________________________________________________

1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at:
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, August 20, 2025.

  Members present: Edward Padgett, Bette Donovan, Terry Kistler, George Borst,
  Jenny Jolly, Scott Snider.

  Members Absent: None.

  Staff Present: Armando Cisneros, Parks & Recreation Specialist, Robyn
  Olsen, Parks & Recreation Specialist, Ken Domer, City Manager.

  It was moved by Bette Donovan and seconded by Edward Padgett to approve the
  minutes of the Wednesday, June 18, 2025 meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: Jen Sance, Senior Companions Director for AgingNext showed a
  video of the history of AgingNext and the Senior Companion Program. Stated in
  the AgingNext packets regarding Senior Companions: “We recruit special
  volunteers, who are active seniors living on a fixed income, to visit isolated
  seniors in their homes. Senior Companions help to prevent loneliness and
  isolation, help with trips to the store, and become friends for life.” More
  information about this and other programs available from AgingNext may be
  found at www.agingnext.org.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Congregate Meals: 550 meals were served to an average of 28 participants in
  June. 584 meals were served to any average of 28 participants in July.

  Meals on Wheels: La Verne Meals served in April totaled 506. Meals served in
  May totaled 510.

4. Bingo Report: Bingo receipts totaled $8,614.00. Ending balance in the
  account through July was $7.50.00 after $8.606.50 in payouts and expenses.
  The number of players in attendance for the month of July: 300.

5. Account Balance: $2,519.21.
 6. Senior Program Fees: All programs are paid.

7. MT. SAC Classes: Summer session ended on Friday, August 15th and the Fall
  session will begin on Monday, August 25th.

8. Aging Next: Total number of La Verne Residents served for the month of
  June was 9. Total number of La Verne Residents served for the month of
  July was 16.

  New Business

9. Facilities Report: Armando stated that the carpet and flooring in Community
  Center might be replaced.

10. Upcoming Events

  •  Friday, August 22nd – Senior Seminar: Eat Smart – Independence at Home, 10:30AM.
  •  Wednesday, August 27th – Senior Seminar: How to Stay in Your Home Longer – Even on a Fixed
  Income – Change Home Mortgage, 10:30AM.
  •  Thursday, August 28th – Excursion: Academy Museum of Motion Pictures, 8:00AM – 5:00PM.
  •  Friday, September 5th – Excursion: A Day in Laguna Beach, 8:30AM – 4:00PM.
  •  Monday, September 8th – Movie Matinee: The Miracle Club, 12:30PM.
  •  Tuesday, September 23rd – Health & Resource Fair and Flu-Shot Clinic, 9:00AM – 11:30AM.

  Public Comments: George mentioned he knows a staff members at LA Fitness
  who may want to give a presentation for the Senior Advisory Committee
  Meeting. Scott mentioned that Hillcrest has a new art display in the lobby. All
  members noted that they wanted to stay on the Senior Advisory Committee.

  Adjourn: The meeting was adjourned at 10:50AM. The next meeting will be held on
  Wednesday, September 20, 2025 at 10:00AM.

  Submitted by:
  Armando Cisneros
  Parks & Recreation Specialist
